intro: Mapal's compiler seen as data: categories (kinds of data), the objects and arrows inside them, and the transformations between them.

categories.name: Text
categories.plain: Source text and positions in it: .mapal files, strings, spans, line tables.

objects.name: Source file (.mapal)
objects.plain: The program text.
objects.lives: disk, then a String on the compiler heap

objects.name: SourceLoc (IR)
objects.plain: A byte range in the source file, copied onto every object and morphism so errors point back to text.
objects.lives: compiler heap: field of Object, Morphism, FuncDef

objects.name: source: &str
objects.plain: The whole program text, the single source of truth; tokens and names only point into it.
objects.lives: compiler process heap: a String read from the .mapal file (or the editor buffer), borrowed by every later stage

objects.name: LineCol
objects.plain: A 1-based line and column, used only for display.

objects.name: LineIndex
objects.plain: A table of where each line starts, so an offset can be turned into a line and column.
objects.lives: compiler process heap: a Vec of line-start offsets borrowing the source

objects.name: SourceLoc (syntax)
objects.plain: A byte range {start, end} in the source; every token and tree node carries one.
objects.lives: two u32 values, copied inline inside Token, tree nodes and Diagnostic

morphisms.name: at
morphisms.plain: Format a position for a message.

morphisms.name: source_dir
morphisms.plain: The folder a relative read path resolves against, recorded in the IR.

morphisms.name: SourceLoc::len / empty_at
morphisms.plain: Length of a span; a zero-width span at a point (for synthesized nodes).

morphisms.name: LineIndex::line_col
morphisms.plain: A byte offset becomes its line and column.

morphisms.name: SourceLoc::new / empty_at
morphisms.plain: Build a span from two offsets, or an empty span at one point.

morphisms.name: slice by span
morphisms.plain: A span gives back its text as source[start..end]; names and tokens keep no text of their own.

categories.name: Tokens
categories.plain: The flat list of words and symbols the lexer cuts the text into.

objects.name: LexOutput
objects.plain: The token list (always ending in an end-of-file token) together with the lexer's errors.

objects.name: KEYWORDS
objects.plain: The fixed list of reserved words.
objects.lives: a constant table in the compiler binary

objects.name: GuardKind
objects.plain: Which guard arrow it is: -true->, -false->, -_-> or -42->; the number sits inside the arrow lexeme.
objects.lives: payload of the Guard token kind

objects.name: TokenKind
objects.plain: What a token is: name, literal, keyword, punctuation, operator, guard arrow, error, end of file.
objects.lives: one small tag inside each Token

objects.name: Token
objects.plain: A kind plus its span; the text is not copied.
objects.lives: compiler heap: element of Vec<Token>, a Copy value

morphisms.name: keyword lookup
morphisms.plain: A word's text is checked against the reserved list to become a keyword token or a plain name.

morphisms.name: unescape_string
morphisms.plain: A string lexeme becomes its real text with escapes resolved.

categories.name: Syntax
categories.plain: The parse tree: items, functions, chains of stages, expressions.

objects.name: Item (Fn, Type, Bind, Error)
objects.plain: One top-level declaration: a function, a type, a top-level value, or a parse error.

objects.name: StageKind
objects.plain: What one stage of a chain does: map, fold, call, bind, guard, fan-out and so on.

objects.name: Block / BlockItem
objects.plain: A braced body: statements, then an optional final chain that is the value.

objects.name: Chain / Stage
objects.plain: A pipeline written with arrows: a start value flowing through stages such as map, fold, call, bind or fan-out.

objects.name: Expr / ExprKind
objects.plain: An expression: literal, name, operator, index, member, struct literal.

objects.name: FnDecl
objects.plain: A function: name, size and format parameters, parameters, return type and body.

objects.name: GuardArm / GuardDiscr
objects.plain: One arm of a conditional (guard) with the case it matches.

objects.name: LoopStmt
objects.plain: A loop statement with its label.

objects.name: Name
objects.plain: A bare span; its text is read from the source.

objects.name: ParseOutput
objects.plain: The program tree plus every lexer and parser error, sorted by position.
objects.lives: compiler heap, handed to lowering, the checker, the formatter-free tools and the language server

objects.name: Program
objects.plain: The whole parse tree: a list of items.
objects.lives: compiler process heap, produced by the parser and borrowed by lower

objects.name: SizeExpr
objects.plain: A size written as arithmetic over numbers and size names, such as tokens * hidden.

objects.name: Ty / TyKind
objects.plain: A written type: a primitive, a named type, an array with a size, or a tuple.

objects.name: TypeDecl
objects.plain: A named record type with fields.

objects.name: SourceLoc (syntax)
objects.plain: A byte range in the source text; lower keys many tables by its (start,end).
objects.lives: compiler heap, 8 bytes inline in every node

morphisms.name: ir_loc
morphisms.plain: Carries a source span across from the parse tree to the IR so graph nodes remember where they came from.

morphisms.name: name_text
morphisms.plain: A name node to its text in the source.

morphisms.name: src_slice
morphisms.plain: A span to the source text it covers.

morphisms.name: Block to its items and tail
morphisms.plain: A body to its statements and its final value chain.

morphisms.name: Chain.stages
morphisms.plain: A chain to the ordered stages the value flows through.

morphisms.name: Program.items
morphisms.plain: A program to its top-level items.

morphisms.name: every node's span
morphisms.plain: Each tree node maps to the source range it covers, so any error or tool can point back at the text.

categories.name: Diagnostics
categories.plain: Error and warning messages with the place they refer to, whichever stage found them.

objects.name: TCode
objects.plain: The check stage's error catalogue: T0101 multiple return writers, T0201 effect in a fan-out.
objects.lives: a tag value, becomes a &'static str code

objects.name: Diagnostic (check findings)
objects.plain: The same Diagnostic type as syntax, always severity Error with no fix.
objects.lives: compiler heap: Vec<Diagnostic>, in the order exclusivity findings then effect findings

objects.name: Scope
objects.plain: The set of names bound so far while walking the tree, used to tell a local value from a callee.
objects.lives: compiler heap: stack of name sets, temporary during the walk

objects.name: Exit code (Res<u8>)
objects.plain: 0 ok, 1 failure, 2 usage, 3 toolchain missing; from the program: 101 trap, 102 driver failure, 103 read failure.

objects.name: LCode
objects.plain: The catalogue of lowering error kinds, each with a stable L-code.

objects.name: Severity
objects.plain: Error or warning.

objects.name: DiagCode
objects.plain: A stable code string: L#### lexer, P#### parser, T#### check.

objects.name: Diagnostic (syntax)
objects.plain: An error with a span, code and message, shared with the parser.

objects.name: SuggestedFix
objects.plain: Replace this span with this text, with a label.

morphisms.name: diag
morphisms.plain: A code, a span and a message become a Diagnostic.

morphisms.name: TCode::code
morphisms.plain: A check error kind to its stable code string.

morphisms.name: to_syntax
morphisms.plain: A source location of the flow graph converts to the syntax span type.

morphisms.name: report
morphisms.plain: Print 'file:line:col error[code] (stage) message'.

morphisms.name: diag
morphisms.plain: Builds a diagnostic.

morphisms.name: LCode::code
morphisms.plain: The code string such as L1201.

morphisms.name: ir_err
morphisms.plain: Translates a builder refusal or seal failure into a source-located error.

morphisms.name: Diagnostic::error / with_fix
morphisms.plain: Build an error at a span, optionally attach a fix.

morphisms.name: Parser::diag / diag_fix
morphisms.plain: The parser records an error, with a cooldown so one mistake does not cascade into many.

categories.name: Names
categories.plain: What names mean while lowering: top-level values, effects, generic sizes.

objects.name: Effects
objects.plain: Which functions are (transitively) effectful, i.e. print, clock or read something.

objects.name: Binding
objects.plain: What a surface name stands for during emission: its graph object, type, mutability and declaration order.

objects.name: CallLog
objects.plain: What emission saw at generic calls: bindings per site, instances called and requested, and widen checks to prove.
objects.lives: compiler heap in a RefCell shared by rounds

objects.name: Globals / TopItem
objects.plain: The program's top-level values, who reads whom, which are computed before running.

objects.name: ScopeStack<T>
objects.plain: A stack of lexical scopes mapping a name to what it stands for; supports poisoning (a name unreadable after a loop) and loop-exit bindings.
objects.lives: compiler heap: Vec of BTreeMaps; one per function being typed or emitted

objects.name: Instance / SiteKey / Generics
objects.plain: One instance of a generic function at concrete sizes/formats, the call site that asked for it, and the table of generic declarations.
objects.lives: compiler heap, rebuilt each monomorphization round

morphisms.name: is_effectful
morphisms.plain: Whether a call to this function carries the IO token.

morphisms.name: Globals::used_by
morphisms.plain: Which top-level values a function reads.

morphisms.name: ScopeStack::poison
morphisms.plain: Marks a name unreadable (reading it later is an error).

morphisms.name: ScopeStack::resolve
morphisms.plain: Finds what a name stands for, innermost scope first.

categories.name: Types
categories.plain: Mapal's types and number formats, as lowering resolves them and the graph stores them.

objects.name: ExpForm
objects.plain: One exp realization: its algorithm constants and error bound per float width.
objects.lives: consts F32 / F64 in the binary

objects.name: NarrowForm
objects.plain: Facts of one narrow format: precision bits, exponent range, unit round-off, largest value, whether it saturates.

objects.name: SplitForm / SplitKind
objects.plain: A way to run an f32 product on a matrix unit by cutting operands into exact parts, with its a-priori error coefficient.
objects.lives: computed on demand; chosen at compile time by the backend

objects.name: NarrowFloat
objects.plain: The narrow float formats bf16, f16, f8e4m3, f8e5m2.

objects.name: Ty / Value
objects.plain: A Mapal type: Int, Float, Narrow, Bool, Unit, Str, IoToken, Tuple, Struct, Array{elem,size}.
objects.lives: compiler heap: field of each Object

objects.name: Value
objects.plain: A constant: i32, i64, u8, f32, f64, narrow bits, bool, string, unit.
objects.lives: compiler heap: Object.value for Constant objects; constant tables in emitted code later

objects.name: Arg
objects.plain: One generic argument: a size or a format.

objects.name: Format
objects.plain: One concrete number format (f32, bf16, i32, ...), the unit of format generics.

objects.name: Kind
objects.plain: A class of formats a generic parameter may range over (number, float, int, precision, ...).

objects.name: GlobalConst
objects.plain: A top-level number computed before the program runs (int, float or bool).

objects.name: Equation / Equations
objects.plain: The size equations one call gives (declared dimension = actual length) that inference solves.

objects.name: SizeEnv
objects.plain: The values of size names and format names in scope (n=4, t=bf16).

objects.name: WTy (working type)
objects.plain: A type that may still be an unknown literal width, resolved by unification.
objects.lives: compiler heap, only during typing of one function

objects.name: BlockSig
objects.plain: The signature of one map/fold body: its input, output and the outer values it captures.

objects.name: FnSig
objects.plain: A function's declared signature (parameter types, return type, effectful?, generic?).

objects.name: TypeInfo
objects.plain: What typing found for one function: the type of each literal and the signature of each map/fold block, keyed by span.
objects.lives: compiler heap, handed from typing to emission

objects.name: TypeTable
objects.plain: All declared Mapal types, resolved to fixed-size IR types, with generic declarations kept for instantiation.
objects.lives: compiler heap: BTreeMap<String, Ty> plus the declarations

morphisms.name: bf16_from_f32 / f8_from_f32
morphisms.plain: Concrete roundings to bf16 and fp8.

morphisms.name: narrow::round / widen
morphisms.plain: Round a number into a narrow format and read it back.

morphisms.name: narrow::widen / round
morphisms.plain: Exact widening and round-to-nearest-even narrowing, the oracle's conversions.

morphisms.name: tf32_parts / bf16_parts
morphisms.plain: Cut an f32 into parts a matrix instruction multiplies exactly.

morphisms.name: Ty::Array elem
morphisms.plain: An array type points to its element type; product types point to their components.

morphisms.name: ty_label
morphisms.plain: Plain-text name of a type for pictures.

morphisms.name: Value::ty
morphisms.plain: The type of a constant.

morphisms.name: admit
morphisms.plain: Decides how a to<target>/widen<target> conversion is realized, or why it is refused.

morphisms.name: embeds
morphisms.plain: Whether every value of one format is exactly a value of another (so widening is lossless).

morphisms.name: Format::of / Format::ty
morphisms.plain: Moves between a format name and its IR scalar type.

morphisms.name: Kind::admits
morphisms.plain: Whether a format belongs to a generic parameter's class.

morphisms.name: eval (size)
morphisms.plain: Computes a size expression's number or reports why it cannot.

morphisms.name: resolve_tykind
morphisms.plain: Turns a written type into a resolved type with known sizes.

morphisms.name: default_of
morphisms.plain: A struct with a default field `_` is read as that field when its context needs it.

morphisms.name: TypeTable::instance
morphisms.plain: Instantiates a generic type at given sizes.

categories.name: Flow
categories.plain: The dataflow graph of a program: objects (values) and morphisms (operations) in sealed functions.

objects.name: Dest
objects.plain: Where the next operation writes: a fresh object, the return slot, or an existing one.

objects.name: FnBuilder
objects.plain: The open builder of one function; emission adds objects and operations through it.

objects.name: FuncKind
objects.plain: Named, MapBody or FoldBody.

objects.name: ObjectKind
objects.plain: Role of a value: Parameter, Temporary, Constant, Return or LoopMerge.

objects.name: Operation
objects.plain: The kind of one graph edge: Map, Fold, Pair, Proj, Phi, Widen, Narrow, ...
objects.lives: compiler heap, tag on each morphism

objects.name: CategoryIr (sealed graph)
objects.plain: The whole graph, frozen after construction; it also carries the fact store, the per-product precision sets and the data directory for file reads.

objects.name: FuncDef
objects.plain: A function (named, map body or fold body): one input object, one output object and its list of morphisms.
objects.lives: compiler heap: SlotMap<FuncId, FuncDef> inside CategoryIr

objects.name: FuncId
objects.plain: Handle naming one function (named function, map body or fold body).
objects.lives: compiler heap: key into SlotMap<FuncId, FuncDef>

objects.name: MorphismId / Morphism
objects.plain: One operation (an edge) from a source object to a target object, tagged with its Operation and source location.
objects.lives: compiler heap: SlotMap<MorphismId, Morphism> inside CategoryIr

objects.name: MorphismId
objects.plain: Typed handle naming one operation edge.
objects.lives: compiler heap: key into SlotMap<MorphismId, Morphism>

objects.name: ObjectId / Object
objects.plain: One typed value in the graph (parameter, temporary, constant, return, loop merge) with its type, optional constant value, name and source location.
objects.lives: compiler heap: SlotMap<ObjectId, Object> inside CategoryIr

objects.name: ObjectId / FuncId
objects.plain: Typed handle (slotmap key) naming one value in the graph.
objects.lives: compiler heap, index into the arena

objects.name: Precision
objects.plain: The set of number formats a float multiplication is allowed to use (full f32, tf32, bf16, f16).
objects.lives: compiler heap: SecondaryMap<MorphismId, Precision> in CategoryIr

objects.name: Ty (IR)
objects.plain: The IR type of a value: number format, array, struct, token.

objects.name: PassId
objects.plain: The seven passes: ConstFold, Cse, Dce, MapFusion, Inline, LiftLoops, Unroll.

objects.name: RewriteResult / RewriteReport
objects.plain: The new graph with rounds taken, how often each pass applied, and whether the graph was skipped as non-canonical.

objects.name: NaturalityLaw
objects.plain: A catalogue of Zip/Enumerate naturality equalities, recorded as data with no pass yet.
objects.lives: a const table in the compiler binary

objects.name: FusionSpec / LiftSpec / LiftKind
objects.plain: What to fuse (two map bodies) and what to lift (a counted loop into a captured Fold or Map).

objects.name: RewritePlan
objects.plain: The read-only product of an analysis, with channels alias, constify, drop, fuse, inline, lift, embed, drop_loops, unroll, keyed by the input graph's ids.
objects.lives: compiler heap: SecondaryMaps, dropped after replay

objects.name: StaticReport
objects.plain: What compile-time evaluation replaced.

morphisms.name: to_mermaid / _flow / _category / _string (+ condensed)
morphisms.plain: The dump-ir --mermaid views.

morphisms.name: Pair{slot,arity}
morphisms.plain: Put one value into slot k of a tuple, struct or array object; products are built edge by edge.

morphisms.name: Proj{index}
morphisms.plain: Take component k out of a product.

morphisms.name: Add/Sub/Mul/Div/Mod/Neg, Eq/Lt/.., And/Or/Not
morphisms.plain: Arithmetic, comparison and logic; binary ones read a 2-tuple product.

morphisms.name: Phi
morphisms.plain: A guard: pick one of two arms by a condition (only the chosen arm's work runs).

morphisms.name: Map{body,captures}
morphisms.plain: Apply a body function to every element.

morphisms.name: Fold{body,captures}
morphisms.plain: Combine all elements with a body function into one value.

morphisms.name: Call(FuncId)
morphisms.plain: Call a named function.

morphisms.name: Index / Update / Zip / Enumerate / Iota / Fill
morphisms.plain: Collection operations: read an element, write one, pair up, number, generate.

morphisms.name: LoopEnter / LoopBack / LoopExit
morphisms.plain: A loop is a real cycle: enter into the merge, a back edge returns the next state, exit leaves it.

morphisms.name: Print / TimeMs / Read
morphisms.plain: Effects: output, clock, file read; ordered by threading a world token.

morphisms.name: Widen / Narrow
morphisms.plain: Convert between a narrow float format and f32, and back with rounding.

morphisms.name: Math(MathFn) (Exp, Sqrt, Sin, Cos)
morphisms.plain: A math builtin, realized later by a target-specific form.

morphisms.name: CategoryIr::out_edges / in_edges
morphisms.plain: Adjacency: which arrows leave and enter a value.

morphisms.name: CategoryIr::owner
morphisms.plain: Which function a value belongs to.

morphisms.name: out_edges / in_edges
morphisms.plain: From a value to the operations that read it, or the one that makes it.

morphisms.name: owner
morphisms.plain: Which function a value belongs to.

morphisms.name: Morphism source / target
morphisms.plain: The two ends of an operation.

morphisms.name: Morphism{source,target,op}
morphisms.plain: The edge record itself: source object, target object, which operation, source span.

morphisms.name: Emitter::emit_convert
morphisms.plain: Emits a number-format conversion by what the format pair admits.

morphisms.name: Emitter::emit_expr_dest
morphisms.plain: Emits one expression as an operation writing to a destination.

morphisms.name: Emitter::emit_loop
morphisms.plain: Emits a loop with carried state, merge, back edge and exits.

morphisms.name: Emitter::emit_map_fold
morphisms.plain: Emits a map or fold whose body is a separately built function with captures as leading inputs.

morphisms.name: Emitter::emit_print / emit_time / emit_read
morphisms.plain: Emits effects as operations that take and return the IO token.

morphisms.name: Emitter::emit_stage
morphisms.plain: Emits one stage of a chain, feeding it the previous stage's value.

morphisms.name: Emitter::emit_value_match
morphisms.plain: Emits a match on values as nested Phi choices with the default innermost.

morphisms.name: RewritePlan::resolve_alias
morphisms.plain: Follows alias chains to the object a value now stands for.

morphisms.name: old id to new id remap
morphisms.plain: The map built while replaying each object through the builder.

categories.name: Diagram
categories.plain: Pictures of a graph (Mermaid text): the flow view, category diagrams and string diagrams.

objects.name: DNode / DEdge / NodeKind / EdgeKind
objects.plain: One box, one arrow, and their style.

objects.name: Diagram
objects.plain: Nodes, subgraphs and edges, ready to be printed as Mermaid.
objects.lives: compiler heap, short-lived; ends as a String

objects.name: FlowGraph / FlowAnchor
objects.plain: The plain-values view of the flow: nodes are values or prints, edges are steps, paths are chains.

morphisms.name: Diagram::render
morphisms.plain: Print the Mermaid text.

morphisms.name: FlowGraph::edge_label
morphisms.plain: Label an arrow in source words.

categories.name: Facts
categories.plain: Everything the compiler has proven about a graph, stored on the graph and read by every later stage.

objects.name: AccessPlan / Hazard
objects.plain: The bytes each operation reads and writes, shared-buffer classes, and the read-after-write, write-after-read, write-after-write ordering edges.

objects.name: Delta
objects.plain: Which cells of a carried array one loop trip writes: a row range or a repeating set of pieces.
objects.lives: compiler heap: SecondaryMap<ObjectId, Delta> in FuncFacts.write_delta

objects.name: MovePlan / CellSite / RowFoldSite / LinearSite
objects.plain: Data-move sites, per-cell map sites, one-value-per-row folds and sums of tile sites.
objects.lives: compiler heap: FuncFacts.move_plan, cell_plan, trap_cell_plan, row_fold, whole_fold, linear_plan

objects.name: ElemPlan / ElemSrc
objects.plain: Each array's element as a closed function of its index (index itself, broadcast, load, pair, apply).

objects.name: EmissionPlan / EmissionClass
objects.plain: Which objects need bytes, which dissolve into views, and how many consumers each has.

objects.name: FootprintPlan / Reach / Edge
objects.plain: What cells of a producer each consumer cell reads, so edges can be checked as staying within rows.

objects.name: GuardSite / GuardArm
objects.plain: Each conditional select with the work exclusive to each arm and whether the arm must be gated (it may trap or is heavy).
objects.lives: compiler heap: Vec<GuardSite> in FuncFacts.guard_plan and guard_structure

objects.name: LastUsePlan
objects.plain: Each value's position, death point, whether it escapes into the output, and whether a loop back edge carries it.

objects.name: LoopPlan / LoopScc
objects.plain: A loop cycle and its canonical shape: initial value, merge, the step that decides to continue, the step that advances, the exit.

objects.name: PathPlan / Task / Checkpoint
objects.plain: Independent parallel tasks, which are splittable bulk operations, and where the host must wait for them.

objects.name: TensorForm
objects.plain: A tile operand described as a dense tensor of at most three axes.
objects.lives: compiler heap: computed on demand from a TileRead (TileRead::tensor_form)

objects.name: TilePlan / TileSite / TileRead
objects.plain: A sum-of-products (matrix-like) site: its rows, columns, depth, the two operand reads, seed, epilogue and narrow formats.
objects.lives: compiler heap: FuncFacts.tile_plan, tile_plan_strided, tile_plan_post, tile_plan_narrow, tile_plan_radix

objects.name: TripSplit / TripPhase
objects.plain: For a counted loop, the trip intervals cut by guards on the counter and the state each interval carries.

objects.name: FoldCombinePlan / FoldCombine / DepLaw
objects.plain: How a fold over blocks of its axis combines partial results, and how each per-row value it reads (factor, shift, rescale, phase) is applied.

objects.name: StepAlgebra / FmaPair / Regroup
objects.plain: Which multiply-add pairs may fuse into one rounding and which fold steps may be regrouped into lane partials plus a tree.

objects.name: BoundsProof
objects.plain: Which Index reads are proven inside their array, and the integer range of each index.

objects.name: PrecisionPlan / NarrowStore
objects.plain: The precisions each product admits, where rounding happens once, and each site's error bound.

objects.name: RadixForm / Digit / RadixTile
objects.plain: An integer index split into digits (x divided by a stride, modulo a radix), which lets convolution and attention reads count as tiles.
objects.lives: compiler heap: SecondaryMap<ObjectId, RadixForm> in FuncFacts.radix_plan

objects.name: FinitePlan
objects.plain: Which float values are proven free of infinity and NaN by interval arithmetic.

objects.name: StaticPlan / StaticRoot / Realize
objects.plain: Which values are computable before the program runs and whether each is embedded as bytes, attempted, or computed at run time.

objects.name: StreamPlan / StreamGroup / StreamGuard / GuardBox
objects.plain: A group proven to run in one pass over windows of an axis (attention style), with each member's role and the mask as a box.

objects.name: StreamPlan / StreamGroup
objects.plain: One pass over windows of an axis (attention-like): the role of each member.

objects.name: UnchangedPlan / CallKeep
objects.plain: For each loop-body array the cells that may differ from the previous trip, and for each call the arguments that are the same every time.

objects.name: ExpForm / NarrowForm / MathForm
objects.plain: The contract of the exponential and of each narrow float format (algorithm constants, error bound, exactness).
objects.lives: compiler heap: plain values; NarrowForm in narrow.rs

objects.name: FactArms
objects.plain: Switches that turn individual fact rules off, used only to compare against the older behaviour (all on by default).
objects.lives: compiler heap: field of Facts, set by CategoryIr::refacted

objects.name: FuncFacts / Facts (fact store)
objects.plain: One write-once slot per function per fact (OnceLock); a query fills its slot on first use and every later call reads it.
objects.lives: compiler heap: SecondaryMap<FuncId, FuncFacts> inside CategoryIr.facts

objects.name: ResidencePlan / Residence
objects.plain: Per array its bytes and peak live bytes between producer and last reader, giving Chip, L2 or DRAM against a cache size.

objects.name: SplitForm / AccModel
objects.plain: A way to do an f32 product on a matrix instruction by cutting operands into exact parts, with its error coefficient.
objects.lives: compiler heap: plain values built by SplitForm::of

objects.name: UnitPlan / UnitGroup / UnitMember / RowMap
objects.plain: Groups of sites that share a block of rows so intermediates stay on chip, each member's role and row mapping.

objects.name: UnitPlan / UnitGroup
objects.plain: Row-block groups of sites that can run together on chip.

morphisms.name: Hazard edges within a loop trip
morphisms.plain: Which operation must wait for which, with the kind of conflict.

morphisms.name: Fact query by object
morphisms.plain: Every fact answers per-object or per-morphism questions: death, delta, residence, finite, class.

morphisms.name: LastUsePlan::death / position / carried_by
morphisms.plain: Where a value dies; the order of an edge; which loop state carries a value across trips.

morphisms.name: fact(f, slot, compute)
morphisms.plain: Look a fact up in the function's slot and compute it only if the slot is empty.

morphisms.name: CategoryIr::fact
morphisms.plain: Return the stored fact, or compute it once from stored inputs and keep it.

morphisms.name: CategoryIr::refacted
morphisms.plain: Copy the graph with an empty fact store and different arms.

morphisms.name: ResidencePlan::at
morphisms.plain: Place of a value given a cache capacity.

categories.name: Values
categories.plain: What a program computes: scalars, arrays and records, and the error bound of a result.

objects.name: Bound
objects.plain: A printed value's error bound split by source: member rounding, summation order, fma, comparison flip, math builtin.
objects.lives: Vec<Bound> returned by run_bound, one per print

objects.name: Tape
objects.plain: Record of every float operation of the exact run: operands, partial derivatives, own deviation.

objects.name: EvalCtx
objects.plain: Working state of one function evaluation: value of each object, staged product slots, guard sites, gated morphisms.
objects.lives: compiler heap, one per function call

objects.name: RunResult / Outcome / Bound
objects.plain: Output text, how it ended, each printed float's composed bound.

objects.name: RunResult
objects.plain: Outcome plus the printed output text.
objects.lives: returned by value; output is a String

objects.name: Abort
objects.plain: Internal early exit (Diverged, Trapped, ReadFailed) threaded as the Err side.
objects.lives: Result error; read failure message in a thread-local READ_FAILURE

objects.name: Outcome
objects.plain: How a run ended: Done(value), Diverged, Trapped(kind), ReadFailed(message).

objects.name: RValue
objects.plain: A runtime value: scalar, tuple, struct, array (shared), world token with its log, tracked scalar (for bounds), unit.
objects.lives: compiler process heap while the oracle runs; arrays in Rc<Vec<RValue>>

objects.name: TrapKind
objects.plain: DivZero or IndexOob.

objects.name: Embedded static value
objects.plain: A value the interpreter computed at compile time and spliced into the graph as constants.
objects.lives: compiler heap, then constants inside the new graph

objects.name: RValue / interpreter result
objects.plain: The interpreter's value for a program or call, compared before and after a rewrite (floats within tolerance).

morphisms.name: component
morphisms.plain: Take a component of a runtime product.

morphisms.name: eval_fn
morphisms.plain: Evaluate one function on an argument.

morphisms.name: native_observable
morphisms.plain: What the compiled program must print and exit with.

morphisms.name: render
morphisms.plain: Print a scalar the way the program shows it.

morphisms.name: Abort::into_outcome
morphisms.plain: Lift an early exit to the public outcome.

categories.name: Target
categories.plain: A chip as measurable properties (SM count, cache sizes, rates) plus the calibration lines that measured them.

objects.name: calibration line
objects.plain: One text line per device: a key made of physical facts, then name=value pairs the probes measured.
objects.lives: a text file on disk (also embedded into the compiler binary as COMMITTED_CALIB, or read from MAPAL_GPU_CALIB or ~/.cache/mapal/gpu-calib)

objects.name: PLACE_* tables
objects.plain: The measured placement numbers written into the compiler, one table per known part (4090, 5090, 5080, 3090, A100, H100, H100 PCIe, a generic Ada one).
objects.lives: compiler process: constants in read-only data

objects.name: CalibSource
objects.plain: Says where the calibration text for this run came from: a file, the committed line, or none.

objects.name: Machine (CPU or GPU class)
objects.plain: The choice inside a profile: a CPU core, or a GPU streaming multiprocessor with its extra facts.

objects.name: Caps
objects.plain: What instructions the chip can run, described by what they move and compute (cp.async copies, matrix shapes, bulk copies, PTX level), never by a version number.

objects.name: DeviceCost
objects.plain: Mapal's own achieved rates on this part (FMA-tile flops per ns, launch cost, copy and zero-pass rates, ...), each from a named calibration run.
objects.lives: compiler process: Option field of Gpu; values come from a constant or the calibration text

objects.name: DeviceQuery
objects.plain: What the driver reports about device 0 (compute capability, SMs, registers, shared memory, L2, clocks, memory bus).
objects.lives: compiler process stack, built from cuDeviceGetAttribute answers

objects.name: Gpu
objects.plain: The facts of one GPU SM and chip: threads per warp, number of SMs, registers, shared memory, L2 bytes, clock, capabilities, and an optional measured cost table.
objects.lives: compiler process: inside TargetProfile (Copy struct, no heap)

objects.name: MatrixOp / MmaShape / MmaFmt
objects.plain: One matrix-multiply instruction as geometry (rows x columns x depth, operand formats, where operands live, rate per clock).
objects.lives: compiler process: static tables inside Caps

objects.name: PlaceFacts
objects.plain: The extra measured numbers the machine model reads: per-operation efficiency curves, primitive rates and latencies, L2 keep, hit curve, sustained clock, each with where it came from.
objects.lives: compiler process: a static table per part (PLACE_RTX_5080 and others) referenced from TargetProfile::place

objects.name: TargetProfile
objects.plain: One part's whole description: name, CPU or GPU class, cache sizes, vector widths, and (for a GPU) the Gpu facts plus measured costs.
objects.lives: compiler process: a const in the binary's read-only data (hand profiles such as RTX_5080) or one built at start-up and leaked into a static (native-gpu)

objects.name: CostOver
objects.plain: A list of optional overrides, one slot per DeviceCost field, read from a calibration line.

objects.name: Src
objects.plain: A tag that goes with every number: measured, queried, declared, derived or nominal. Derived and nominal numbers are marked as less certain.

morphisms.name: calib_line
morphisms.plain: Reads one device's line into numbers.

morphisms.name: calib_supply
morphisms.plain: Finds the calibration text: env file, cache file, then the committed line, or none.

morphisms.name: caps_of_cc
morphisms.plain: Turns the compute capability into the instruction abilities once, at the boundary.

morphisms.name: native_gpu
morphisms.plain: Query the driver and read measured calibration; never a name lookup.

morphisms.name: resolve
morphisms.plain: Named profile or detected native; unknown name is an error.

morphisms.name: with_host
morphisms.plain: A GPU build also carries its host's CPU facts.

morphisms.name: Gpu::matrix_op
morphisms.plain: Looks up the matrix instruction that fits a format and operand location.

morphisms.name: DeviceQuery::calib_key
morphisms.plain: Turns the physical facts into the key that finds this part's calibration line.

morphisms.name: DeviceQuery::device
morphisms.plain: Asks the driver (libcuda opened at run time) for device 0's attributes.

morphisms.name: DeviceQuery::profile
morphisms.plain: Builds the profile of this machine's GPU from the query and the measured rates.

morphisms.name: Gpu::dram_bytes_per_us_per_sm
morphisms.plain: The share of memory bandwidth one SM gets.

morphisms.name: Gpu::l2_keep_bytes
morphisms.plain: How many bytes of a repeatedly read set the L2 actually keeps.

morphisms.name: Gpu::warps_per_scheduler
morphisms.plain: How full a grid keeps the chip's schedulers.

morphisms.name: TargetProfile::gpu
morphisms.plain: Picks out the GPU facts, if this is a GPU profile.

categories.name: Machine
categories.plain: The abstract machine the placement search prices: levels of memory, rates, latencies.

objects.name: Bound
objects.plain: Which end of the intervals to read: slow, value or fast.

objects.name: Fact<T>
objects.plain: A value with its source tag and a low and high end.

objects.name: Cache / Keep / Policy
objects.plain: A cache place's line size, how many bytes it keeps for each access pattern, and per-access policies (evict first, persist).

objects.name: Cost
objects.plain: A primitive's rate, latency and loaded latency in ns at one bound, with a flag for borrowed or marked inputs.

objects.name: Dispatch
objects.plain: How work reaches executors: slot start timing, launch costs by mode, atomics, zero pass, clock, barriers.

objects.name: Exec / ExecKind
objects.plain: A level of compute: device, unit (SM), scheduler, warp group, lane, with how many instances sit under each parent.

objects.name: Machine
objects.plain: The whole machine: executors, places, capacity groups, unit resources, issue pipes, operations, movers, dispatch and measured primitives.
objects.lives: compiler process heap (Vecs); one per part, cached per process

objects.name: Mover
objects.plain: A way to move bytes from one place to another and who issues it (load, async copy, bulk copy).

objects.name: Op
objects.plain: One compute instruction as a row of geometry and rate (FMA lane, warp matrix product, warpgroup product) with formats, fragment registers and efficiency points.

objects.name: Pipe / Class
objects.plain: How many instructions of a class (math, matrix, shared, global, barrier) a unit issues per clock.

objects.name: Place
objects.plain: Somewhere bytes can live: registers, shared memory, L2, DRAM, tensor memory, host. Has capacity, how it is managed, banking, backing place and reach.

objects.name: Prim / PrimOf
objects.plain: A measured primitive (a compute row, a load, a copy, a panel stream, a store, a reduction, a barrier, a launch) with rate, latency and concurrency each as a Fact.

objects.name: Reach
objects.plain: An executor's link to a place: bandwidth per instance, total bandwidth, loaded latency, transaction size.

objects.name: Resource
objects.plain: A per-unit capacity a running block occupies (registers, threads, slots, scratchpad bytes); occupancy is derived from it.

morphisms.name: Fact::rate / Fact::cost
morphisms.plain: Read a rate at its slow or fast end, a cost at the opposite end.

morphisms.name: Machine::cost
morphisms.plain: A primitive's price: its measured row, else a neighbour's, else derived from other facts and marked.

morphisms.name: Machine::near
morphisms.plain: Finds the closest measured row to borrow when one is missing.

morphisms.name: Machine::occupancy
morphisms.plain: How many blocks fit on a unit given what each takes.

morphisms.name: Machine::reach
morphisms.plain: How an executor level gets at a place.

morphisms.name: Machine::rows
morphisms.plain: Lists every numeric fact with its provenance for the evidence report.

morphisms.name: Exec.parent
morphisms.plain: The level above (lane to warp to scheduler to SM to device).

morphisms.name: Place.backing
morphisms.plain: Where a miss or spill goes (L2 to DRAM).

categories.name: Schedule
categories.plain: A way of running a piece of work: tile shapes, launch geometry, residency, placement picks.

objects.name: Chain
objects.plain: A chain of dependent launches that become one persistent kernel.

objects.name: Block / Slices / Stage
objects.plain: Rows per block, a row cut over blocks, and the staged shared-memory window.

objects.name: UMember / UKind / USrc
objects.plain: A member (fold, cell, or tile), its kind, and where each input comes from.

objects.name: Unit
objects.plain: A row-block group: one launch, rows threads, ordered members, operands, optional slices or stream.

objects.name: Arithmetic
objects.plain: What the kernel computes with: separate mul-add, ordered FMA, TF32/half/split matrix instructions.

objects.name: Combine
objects.plain: How partial sums are joined: none, split atomic, workspace, stream-K.

objects.name: Launch
objects.plain: The concrete kernel choice the emitter uses: tile kind, block size, grid, combine, optimization switches.

objects.name: MmaWalk
objects.plain: Tile grid rounds across SMs versus a stream-K walk on the matrix pipes.

objects.name: SiteCand
objects.plain: One candidate launch of a site's table with its arms and flipped axes.

objects.name: SiteTable
objects.plain: A site's candidate table on its way to the launch point.
objects.lives: compiler heap; constant table in the host module at run time

objects.name: Refuse
objects.plain: Why a launch was not added to an open group (args, block, smem, occupancy, waves).
objects.lives: compiler stack; reported in evidence lines

objects.name: HzGroup
objects.plain: Launches merged side by side or as a persistent chain, with each member's level.

objects.name: Shape
objects.plain: A launch's grid and resource use, the input of the merge rule.

objects.name: DevSite
objects.plain: A device site: a tile site or a row fold.

objects.name: Arena
objects.plain: One device allocation per function, with a byte offset for each member whose lifetime allows sharing.
objects.lives: compiler heap (plan); at run time one slab in GPU global memory

objects.name: Batch
objects.plain: A loop whose skippable first trips are written once by one launch before entry.

objects.name: Carry
objects.plain: A loop state kept on the device across trips: merge, next value, views, exit.
objects.lives: compiler heap; at run time one device buffer per carry

objects.name: Cell
objects.plain: A per-cell map run as its own one-thread-per-cell kernel.

objects.name: DeltaUp
objects.plain: An upload that sends only the rows a trip wrote.
objects.lives: compiler heap; a first-pass flag slot on the host stack

objects.name: Epi
objects.plain: A tile with its epilogue cells grouped so the cell work rides on the tile launch.

objects.name: Gen
objects.plain: A producer computed on the device (id, body function, element count).

objects.name: ResidentPlan
objects.plain: The whole decision record of one function: uploads, keeps, device-built producers, carries, arena, units, merged launches.
objects.lives: compiler heap, a pure function of Flow, profile and optimization switches; computed before the walk

objects.name: RetainCell
objects.plain: A cell whose output differs from the previous trip only in a row range, so later trips launch only that range.

objects.name: Retained
objects.plain: A tile site over a carried array that recomputes only the rows the last trip wrote.

objects.name: Stream
objects.plain: One pass over windows of an axis (attention shape): rows per block, window, threads, cp.async, split-KV, matrix format.

objects.name: GpuArms
objects.plain: The user's measurement flags: which optimization switches to force ON or OFF, plus placement search arms.
objects.lives: compiler process: options passed down from the command line

objects.name: GpuRungs
objects.plain: The set of on/off optimization switches chosen for one site (wide tile, async copy, split, stream-K, machine-place, ...).
objects.lives: compiler process: Copy struct inside each Launch

objects.name: PLACE_BAND_PM / PLACE_NULL
objects.plain: The model's error band by bounding term and the measurement null (2 percent), derived from the replay's residuals.

objects.name: Emitter (Lowering)
objects.plain: One present kernel family (naive cell, FMA tile, mma, wgmma, wgmma warp-specialized) acting as a Lowering over one site and profile.

objects.name: Placed
objects.plain: The search's pick for a site: the launch to take, its plan name, the ; mapal.place line, whether open, whether the rules' launch was kept.
objects.lives: compiler process heap; cached in a thread-local PICKS map keyed by site, part, arms and order

objects.name: place_replay.tsv
objects.plain: One row per measured arm of a site on a part: extents, formats, order, arm name and measured time.
objects.lives: text file in the repo; read by tests

objects.name: Face
objects.plain: The numeric promise being compiled for (exact, default, TF32 and so on), which changes which optimization switches are allowed.

objects.name: rung_replay.tsv
objects.plain: One line per cited measurement: the part's properties, fill and whether the optimization switch won; replayed against the rules.
objects.lives: text file in the repo; read by a test

objects.name: Corner
objects.plain: One choice of slow or fast end for each of compute, cache, memory, dispatch; sixteen corners in all.

objects.name: Flow
objects.plain: One resource of a loop trip: work, rate, latency and bytes in flight.

objects.name: Terms / Phase
objects.plain: The evaluator's result: per-phase times by resource (compute, issue, dram, cache, latency, atomics, epilogue, barriers), occupancy, misses, marked facts, infeasibility reason.
objects.lives: compiler process heap; one line written into the emitted module as a ; mapal.place comment

objects.name: Move
objects.plain: How a slot's panels arrive: register loads, async copies, bulk boxes.

objects.name: Declared
objects.plain: What a lowering says its schedule costs: lanes, registers, shared bytes, instructions per class per trip, bytes in flight, mover.
objects.lives: compiler process heap, paired with each candidate

objects.name: Grid / Order / Reads
objects.plain: A traversal as the cache sees it (tiles, panels, slot sizes, access order) and the bytes missed per slice family.
objects.lives: compiler process stack; results memoized in thread-local hash maps

objects.name: Fold
objects.plain: How free the order of the k sum is: any, fixed grouping, sequential.

objects.name: Traversal / Comb
objects.plain: The order tiles are visited: ordered with raster, split into k partitions (atomic or workspace), stream-K walk, hybrid, persistent.

objects.name: Level / Home / Bind
objects.plain: A tile of m x n x k bound to an executor level or place, with each operand's place, layout and buffering depth.

objects.name: Schedule
objects.plain: One placement: the operation, tile levels with where each operand lives, groups, traversal, launch mode, cache policies, occupancy.

objects.name: Site
objects.plain: What the dataflow says about one tile site: sizes m, n, k, batch, operand bytes, fold freedom, allowed formats, operands already resident.
objects.lives: compiler process stack or heap, built per site

objects.name: Opts
objects.plain: Search parameters: how many candidates to keep, error band per bounding term, null, traversal kinds allowed.

objects.name: Cand / Ranked / Stats
objects.plain: A priced candidate (schedule, counts, terms, times at slow, value, fast, every corner), the search's ranked result, and counters of what was walked and pruned.

objects.name: Verdict
objects.plain: The index of the chosen candidate and the reasons it is open (a flip at some corner, or a tie).

objects.name: Wisdom file line
objects.plain: One stored decision: key, site, pick, repetitions, nanoseconds, kernel names.
objects.lives: a tab-separated file wisdom-<device>.tsv under MAPAL_WISDOM, XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache/mapal

objects.name: choice_memo
objects.plain: The pick already decided for a table, found by the table's address.
objects.lives: a small direct-mapped array in host static memory

objects.name: mapal_cand
objects.plain: One candidate's launch recipe: main kernel id, reduce kernel id, bytes to zero, workspace bytes, grid, block, shared memory.
objects.lives: a constant table in the emitted host module (56 bytes each; layout declared by SITE_DECL in the backend)

objects.name: mapal_site_reg
objects.plain: A site, its table, its length and its flags (re-run safe, output already zeroed, cooperative, operand in DRAM).
objects.lives: the constant array @mapal_sites in the host module

morphisms.name: flag apply
morphisms.plain: Each --gpu-off=name and similar flag toggles one arm.

morphisms.name: member source
morphisms.plain: Where an input comes from: another member, global memory, the cell index, or a closed-form law.

morphisms.name: kernel_id
morphisms.plain: Content hash naming a kernel so equal sites share one.

morphisms.name: launch_in
morphisms.plain: The launch a site gets under an emission's order.

morphisms.name: launch_split
morphisms.plain: The launch with the k fold cut or streamed.

morphisms.name: arena offset
morphisms.plain: Where a member sits in the arena slab.

morphisms.name: chain stream
morphisms.plain: Which stream each straight-line device site goes on.

morphisms.name: upload / keep / elem
morphisms.plain: Per object: copy in after producer, never copy out, or copy out one element.

morphisms.name: devgen / skip
morphisms.plain: Per producer: build it on the device, or skip it because every reader is device-built.

morphisms.name: free_after
morphisms.plain: Which device buffers die right after this morphism.

morphisms.name: zero_by / zero_after
morphisms.to: kernel or step that zeroes its output
morphisms.plain: The kernel or earliest step that clears an atomic site's output bytes.

morphisms.name: launch_of
morphisms.plain: Turns a placed schedule back into the kernel geometry the emitter lowers.

morphisms.name: lowering_of
morphisms.plain: Names which emitter a launch belongs to.

morphisms.name: machine_of
morphisms.plain: Reads every physical fact and its source into the target-neutral machine; missing facts become marked intervals.

morphisms.name: schedule_of
morphisms.plain: Writes the rules' launch as a schedule, so the rules' choice can be the search's incumbent.

morphisms.name: schedule_of / launch_of
morphisms.plain: The rules' launch as a schedule and back.

morphisms.name: site_of
morphisms.plain: Reads a dataflow tile site as extents, operand bytes, fold freedom, allowed formats.

morphisms.name: table_rungs
morphisms.plain: The optimization switches the site's table carries beyond the launch.

morphisms.name: warm_of
morphisms.plain: Reads the residence facts to know operands kept from the previous call.

morphisms.name: Emitter::declare
morphisms.plain: Each kernel family states its footprint and per-trip instruction counts.

morphisms.name: grid_spread_pm
morphisms.plain: How evenly a grid spreads across SMs.

morphisms.name: row_split_pays
morphisms.plain: Split a long row fold across blocks.

morphisms.name: rungs
morphisms.plain: The main rule chain: the chip's numbers plus the site's fill give the optimization switch values.

morphisms.name: split_rate_pays
morphisms.plain: Does a split-precision matrix product beat the plain FMA tile at its achieved rate.

morphisms.name: stream_ld_pays
morphisms.plain: Mark a read-once operand as streaming so it does not push other data out of L2.

morphisms.name: streamk_epi_pays
morphisms.plain: Does stream-K with an epilogue pay.

morphisms.name: vec_cells_pay
morphisms.plain: Do vector cells beat scalar ones given the DRAM share.

morphisms.name: wide_fma_pays
morphisms.plain: Does the wider FMA tile win at this grid size.

morphisms.name: ws_persist_pays
morphisms.plain: Does a persistent warp-specialized kernel pay.

morphisms.name: Lowering::slots
morphisms.plain: A lowering lists its tile schedules that fit the chip's capacities.

morphisms.name: Lowering::declare
morphisms.plain: Checks constraints and gives the counts.

morphisms.name: Lowering::search_domain / point
morphisms.plain: Exposes the schedule space as coordinates for the branch and bound.

morphisms.name: lru_bytes
morphisms.plain: Exact LRU misses over a trace.

morphisms.name: trace
morphisms.plain: The exact order slices are touched, for the simulator.

morphisms.name: reads
morphisms.plain: Bytes a cache misses on a grid's traversal.

morphisms.name: Schedule::plan
morphisms.plain: A short readable name of the placement.

morphisms.name: Schedule::tiles / panels
morphisms.plain: How many output tiles and k panels a placement makes.

morphisms.name: ops
morphisms.plain: Step 1 of the space: which instructions can run this site.

morphisms.name: traversals
morphisms.plain: Step 4: the traversals and their parameters over the slots a footprint allows.

morphisms.name: choice_lookup
morphisms.plain: Hash the table and the module text; look it up in the wisdom file.

morphisms.name: choice_site
morphisms.plain: The decision rule shared by device and emulator.

morphisms.name: mapal_gpu_site
morphisms.plain: Run a site: pick a candidate (forced, remembered, timed, or the compiler's first) and launch it.

morphisms.name: mapal_gpu_sites
morphisms.plain: The host hands its tables to the runtime before init.

morphisms.name: sites_resolve / choice_preset
morphisms.plain: At load, decide every pick that needs no run and prepare every candidate's kernel.

categories.name: Code
categories.plain: Generated programs: LLVM text, device modules, PTX, object files and executables.

objects.name: ArenaPlan / ArenaKey
objects.plain: Offset of each buffer in the function's one zone and its capacity.
objects.lives: compiler heap, a pure function of the graph

objects.name: FnEmit (CUDA)
objects.plain: Per-function host-side emission state.

objects.name: KernelSet
objects.plain: Kernels emitted for a function, deduplicated by structural shape.

objects.name: Qualifiers / FnQual
objects.plain: Host, device or both for each function.

objects.name: Site
objects.plain: A launch-form bulk operation and its kernel name k<fn>_<site>.

objects.name: TrapCaps
objects.plain: Which functions and launches can trap, so only they get a readback check.

objects.name: EmitError (CUDA)
objects.plain: Unsupported feature with a SourceLoc, or internal.

objects.name: CUDA translation unit
objects.plain: The .cu text; the String is the artifact.
objects.lives: compiler heap String; later a file on the GPU box

objects.name: EmitOpts (CUDA)
objects.plain: Only a perf-timing switch.

objects.name: ProdStruct
objects.plain: A struct generated for a product type.
objects.lives: compiler heap; a struct definition in the .cu

objects.name: @mapal_gsync
objects.plain: The grid barrier used between levels of a persistent kernel.
objects.lives: device function in the device module; barrier counter in GPU global memory

objects.name: UnitGen
objects.plain: Builder for the kernel text of a unit.

objects.name: UnitKernel
objects.plain: Kernel text of one unit plus the helper bodies it calls.

objects.name: LoopBuf
objects.plain: How a loop state's buffers are shared between trips: its own buffer, or a coloured set of spares.
objects.lives: compiler heap, decided before the walk

objects.name: Root
objects.plain: Whose bytes a view points at: an object, a loop-state position, or outside the function.

objects.name: Loop
objects.plain: A canonical loop of the function: its LoopPlan and the set of morphisms in its body.

objects.name: ParOrder
objects.plain: For the parallel entry: which task each morphism belongs to and which tasks come before which.

objects.name: %mapal_site_reg
objects.plain: Registry row of a table, handed to the runtime before init.
objects.lives: private constant @mapal_sites in the host module

objects.name: %mapal_cand
objects.plain: One row of a site's candidate table: kernel id, reduce id, zero bytes, workspace, grid, block, smem.
objects.lives: constant table in the host module; C twin read by the runtime

objects.name: device module text
objects.plain: The nvptx64 LLVM unit: one kernel per live site, cell, generator, row fold, unit.

objects.name: CellGeo
objects.plain: Grid and shape of a one-thread-per-cell kernel.

objects.name: EpiSite / EpiKernel
objects.plain: A tile kernel with epilogue cells folded into it.

objects.name: Kernel text builder
objects.plain: String builder for one kernel, separate from the host function around the site.

objects.name: HzSpec
objects.plain: Parsed merged-launch description read back from the host text.

objects.name: FnAttrs
objects.plain: Per function: is it clean (reads only, never traps or prints) and does it loop; decides readonly/nounwind/willreturn.
objects.lives: compiler heap: two SecondaryMaps keyed by FuncId

objects.name: FnEmit (LLVM)
objects.plain: All the state of emitting one function: slot name of each object, the alloca block, the body text, the facts it reads.
objects.lives: compiler heap, one per function, dropped after emit_ordered returns its text

objects.name: HostEmit
objects.plain: Where the host waits for tasks: checkpoints, pinned tasks, waits that must fire before a loop.

objects.name: TileCtx
objects.plain: The per-site numbers a CPU matrix tile is emitted with: tile sizes, packing, offsets.
objects.lives: compiler stack/heap while a site is emitted

objects.name: EmitError (LLVM)
objects.plain: Why an emission was refused: an unsupported feature at a source place, or an internal break.

objects.name: Order
objects.plain: How a tile's sum over k may be ordered: sequential, fixed split, or free.

objects.name: ; mapal.* comment lines
objects.plain: Evidence lines in the module text (plan, host, ptx) read by the checker scripts.

objects.name: Emission
objects.plain: Host LLVM IR text, optional device LLVM IR, resolved profile name, fold orders.

objects.name: EmitOpts (LLVM)
objects.plain: The knobs of one emission: target name, float face (contract, order), tiling, packing, timing, GPU arms.

objects.name: FoldOrder
objects.plain: A split fold compiled in fixed order, kept so the interpreter can replay the same grouping.

objects.name: StrGlobal
objects.plain: One string literal turned into a private LLVM global with its byte length.
objects.lives: compiler heap: SecondaryMap<ObjectId, StrGlobal>; at run time a constant in the module's read-only data

objects.name: Ptx
objects.plain: The PTX ISA version and SM a module declares and llc is told by -mattr.

objects.name: Reuse
objects.plain: How a tile operand is reused across the i axis (new row each step, same row, shifting window).

objects.name: mapal_gpu.c / mapal_choice.h as embedded text
objects.plain: The C runtime and its header are embedded into the mapal binary and written next to each GPU build.
objects.lives: include_str! in the mapal executable; written to <exe>.mapal_gpu.c

objects.name: PTX file
objects.plain: The device program made by opt and llc.
objects.lives: disk <exe>.ptx; its path goes to the program in MAPAL_PTX

objects.name: Executable
objects.plain: The linked native program.

categories.name: Run
categories.plain: A running program: host memory, tasks, device memory, output and exit code.

objects.name: arena zone
objects.plain: One cudaMalloc per function covering non-loop buffers, released at function exit unless an escape points into it.

objects.name: device twin
objects.plain: __device__ copy of a token-free function used inside kernels.
objects.lives: GPU code; per-thread locals in registers or local memory

objects.name: loop buffer
objects.plain: A per-buffer cudaMalloc inside loop cones; carried arrays swap pointers at the back edge.

objects.name: packed panel
objects.plain: A right-hand matrix repacked tile by tile for the CPU matmul loop.

objects.name: heap array buffer
objects.plain: Bytes of an array result, allocated and freed at last use.

objects.name: per-object slot
objects.plain: The stack cell of one value, written once by its producing operation.
objects.lives: host stack (alloca in the entry block); registers after LLVM mem2reg

objects.name: tile registers / shared memory
objects.plain: Accumulators sit in registers; panels staged in shared memory (cp.async or TMA).

objects.name: %Frame
objects.plain: The struct holding every object's value of one function call.
objects.lives: host stack frame, or the mapal-rt frame arena when too large (@mapal_rt_frame_alloc)

objects.name: device arena slab
objects.plain: The function's one cuMemAlloc, aligned to 256 bytes.

objects.name: task pool run
objects.plain: The handle of one parallel run of split tasks.

objects.name: DeviceSlot (uint64_t* slot)
objects.plain: A u64 device address in a frame slot, filled lazily by mapal_gpu_alloc / mapal_gpu_arena.
objects.lives: a host stack or frame slot owned by the emitted code; the bytes are in GPU global memory

objects.name: stream chain
objects.plain: A CUDA stream a chain of dependent sites runs on.

objects.name: PinnedRange
objects.plain: A host array locked in memory so uploads can be asynchronous.
objects.lives: host memory registered with the driver; a static array of (pointer, bytes)

objects.name: mapal_gpu_site
objects.plain: The call that launches a site: picks among the candidates at load time and then runs the pick.
objects.lives: host code; kernels in GPU code memory

objects.name: module trap word
objects.plain: A device cell records a trap here; the next host checkpoint reads it.

objects.name: Module and fn_entry
objects.plain: The loaded PTX module and a table from kernel name to function handle, built by scanning the PTX text for entries.
objects.lives: GPU module in the driver; table is a malloc'd array on the host

objects.name: Stream slots and events
objects.plain: Eight non-blocking chains plus the default stream, each joined to program order by an event.
objects.lives: CUDA driver objects; the counters are static C arrays

objects.name: mapal_dev_trap word
objects.plain: A 64-bit global in the device module where a kernel records a trap (all ones means none).
objects.lives: GPU global memory inside the module

objects.name: Trace totals
objects.plain: Counters of time and bytes per phase, printed at exit under MAPAL_GPU_TRACE.
objects.lives: a static struct in the host process

objects.name: Arena (device)
objects.plain: One big device allocation that many buffers share, released as a whole.
objects.lives: GPU global memory; the table of arenas is a malloc'd array on the host

objects.name: tmap_e (tensor-map recipe)
objects.plain: How to build a copy descriptor for a kernel that uses bulk tile copies, read from the module text.
objects.lives: host heap; encoded descriptors are passed as kernel arguments

objects.name: TaskState
objects.plain: Waiting, Running or Done.

objects.name: FrameSlot (FRAME)
objects.plain: Scratch memory of one function call, released when the call returns.
objects.lives: host heap; per-thread Vec of (address, layout) in a thread_local

objects.name: Trap
objects.plain: A language error (divide by zero, index out of range): a code 0 or 1 that ends the process with exit 101.
objects.lives: a u32 argument; in a parallel run the first one is kept in Run.trap (an atomic u64)

objects.name: ArenaBlock (ARENA)
objects.plain: One heap block handed out by mapal_rt_alloc; all blocks are released together at the end.
objects.lives: host heap; the list of (address, layout) is a Vec behind one global mutex

objects.name: ReadFailure
objects.plain: A failed file read: a message and a position in the program order; exit code 103.

objects.name: FlowParRun
objects.plain: The opaque handle the emitted code holds for a Run.
objects.lives: host heap; the pointer sits in an emitted stack slot

objects.name: Pool
objects.plain: The worker threads, one queue and one parking spot per lane.

objects.name: Run
objects.plain: One parallel region: its tasks, the frame pointer they share, the first trap, and a wake-up signal.

objects.name: TaskDef
objects.plain: What one parallel task is: its kernel function, element count, rank, slice size, width.
objects.lives: host heap, filled by the emitted program's mapal_par_task calls

objects.name: TaskBuild / TaskRt
objects.plain: A task while the graph is being built (definition, dependents, count of unmet dependencies), and after it is sealed (atomic counters).
objects.lives: host heap: Mutex<Vec<TaskBuild>> turned into a Box<[TaskRt]> by seal

objects.name: Work (slice)
objects.plain: A range [lo, hi) of one task, queued for a worker.
objects.lives: host heap, inside a per-lane VecDeque

morphisms.name: trap check after launch

morphisms.name: mapal_gpu_event

morphisms.name: mapal_gpu_launchv

morphisms.name: mapal_gpu_sync
morphisms.plain: Wait for all device work.

morphisms.name: mapal_gpu_trap_arm / trap_poll / trap_word

morphisms.name: mapal_read / mapal_read_task

morphisms.name: mapal_rt_alloc
morphisms.plain: Get a block that lives until the program ends.

morphisms.name: mapal_rt_frame_mark / alloc / release

morphisms.name: mapal_rt_free_all
morphisms.plain: Release every block.

morphisms.name: mapal_time_ms / mapal_perf_begin / mapal_perf_end
